Native Salesforce named Apex tests at source and transport APIs 62.0 and 67.0, using System.runAs with users set to fr_FR (Europe/Paris) and en_US (America/Los_Angeles), with language en_US. The observation is Decimal.valueOf('1234567.89').format(). Rows 2–5 in org.tsv retain only the formatted numeric result. French group separators are U+202F. The named tests and helper sources were deployed successfully to an isolated scratch org; assertions carried the results. These observations do not cover negative numbers, other numeric types, or other French locale keys.

A separate named runAs matrix at source and transport API 62.0 and 67.0 supplies numeric.tsv rows 2–49. It records fr_FR and en_US Decimal zero, negative, precision and rounding controls plus positive Integer and Long grouping. Source methods each ran with both locale users in an isolated scratch org. No Double result was captured.

A later named runAs capture at source and transport API 62.0 and 67.0 (Standard User inserted per test, locale fr_FR or en_US, language en_US, Europe/Paris) adds numeric.tsv rows 50–73: negative Integer -1234567, -1234 and -999, negative Long -1234567 and -1234567890123, and positive Long 1234567890123. Positive controls matched the earlier rows. A negative sign is ASCII U+002D and groups use U+202F under fr_FR. Isolated 1-day scratch org, deleted and verified gone. The anonymous route cannot set a user locale (System.runAs is test-only), so it was not run.
